description: This PHP source file defines the VersionAPI class, which provides an endpoint to retrieve the version information of the OrangeHRM system through an API. The class implements methods for handling API requests related to version info, including retrieving version data and validation rules, with implementation only for the 'getOne' method. Other methods throw 'not implemented' exceptions.

classes.name: VersionAPI
classes.description: Provides API endpoint for retrieving the system version information of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Returns the API version information encapsulated in an EndpointResourceResult object.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the 'getOne' API request, excluding the 'PARAMETER_ID' parameter.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Stub method for updating version info, not implemented.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Stub method for validation of update, throws not implemented exception.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Stub method for deleting version info, not implemented.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Stub method for validation of delete operation, throws not implemented exception.
